rows.answer: Yes, you are a resident individual for tax year 2027 because, under Section 82(d) of the Income Tax Ordinance, a Pakistani citizen who is not a resident taxpayer of any other country qualifies as a resident individual, even though you were present in the UAE for more than 182 days (you are not a resident taxpayer of the UAE) [1].

rows.answer: نہیں، آپ اس ٹیکس سال (2027) میں پاکستان کے رہائشی ٹیکس دہندہ نہیں شمار ہوں گے کیونکہ آپ نے پاکستان میں صرف 170 دن (183 دن سے کم) گزارے ہیں اور ساتھ ہی آپ نے کسی دوسرے ملک (متحدہ عرب امارات) میں 195 دن (182 دن سے زیادہ) گزارے ہیں، جو سیکشن 82 کی شرائط (a) اور (d) دونوں کو پورا نہیں کرتا۔ اس لیے آپ کی رہائش کا معیار پورا نہیں ہوتا۔

rows.answer: Nahi, aap is tax year 2027 ke liye Pakistan ke resident individual nahi samjhay jayenge kyun ke aap Pakistan mein sirf 170 din maujood the jo 183 din se kam hai, aur aap Dubai mein 195 din rahe jo 182 din se zyada hai, is liye Section 82 ke koi bhi shart (a) ya (d) poori nahi hoti [1]

rows.answer: For capital gains on the sale of shares, a person who is not on the Active Taxpayers’ List (non‑filer) is taxed at the rate prescribed in Division I for individuals, which cannot be less than 15% when the holding period does not exceed one year; for holding periods of more than one year the rates are 12.5%, 10%, 7.5%, 5%, 2.5% and 0% respectively, as shown in the table and applied equally to non‑filers [1]. For dividends, a non‑filer is subject to the non‑ATL withholding tax rate of 30% (the standard rate for persons not on the ATL) [7].
